blocks.content: Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Learned about the value of visualizing spreadsheet data through observability
- Learned about the advantages of using the Google Sheets data source
- Installed and added the Google Sheets data source in Grafana Cloud
- Created a Google API key for spreadsheet access
- Configured the Google Sheets data source and verified the connection

---

### More to explore

- [Quick start: create a sample dashboard](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-googlesheets-datasource/latest/#quick-start-create-a-sample-dashboard) — build a panel from the public demo spreadsheet
- [Query editor](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-googlesheets-datasource/latest/query-editor/) — query spreadsheet data and build panels
- [Template variables](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-googlesheets-datasource/latest/template-variables/) — create dynamic dashboards
- [Alerting](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-googlesheets-datasource/latest/alerting/) — create alert rules from Google Sheets queries
- [Configure a service account (JWT)](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-googlesheets-datasource/latest/configure/#authenticate-with-a-service-account-jwt) — read private spreadsheets
